verdict.line: You lose prolonged ranged exchanges before level 3 and whenever Disdain is up, but you win forced all-ins once his E is down or your R isolates him at 6.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no gap-closer besides the 700-range pull on E (Death's Grasp), while Urgot pokes from range with Q (Corrosive Charge) and can dash-and-throw you away with E (Disdain) to reset neutral. That mismatch in who controls distance is the entire reason the aggregate 50.7% winrate drops to 43% here — Morde's equalizer is R (Realm of Death), which drags Urgot into a melee-only duel where his range stops mattering.

theirWindow.what: He can poke with Q (Corrosive Charge) and then dash in to throw you out of range with Disdain if you commit. Don't walk up to melee here — you'll eat the poke and get shoved back for free.

yourWindow.when: Disdain (E) just used or on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no tool to create separation. Close with E (Death's Grasp) and follow with Q (Obliterate) — at rank 1 that's an 8-second cooldown, so you can re-engage fast if he flinches.

powerCurve.note: Realm of Death forces isolated duels
Purge ramps down, offsets your sustain
Rylai's slow-stick plus Conqueror sustain wins

start.why: The 49.1% win rate over 112 games is the better-performing start; the mana regen and AP keep your Q/E trades funded while you wait out his poke phase rather than trying to out-sustain autos directly.

boots.why: 85.1% pick rate and the right call here — his passive (Echoing Flames) triggers off autos and Purge, so flat damage reduction against that auto-attack chip matters more than magic resist.

core.why: The slow on Q and E is your only answer to a kiting ranged champion with a disengage tool — it keeps him inside your E pull range after the first hit lands.
Omnivamp lets you win the extended trades his Echoing Flames procs are designed to grind out, and the empowered-after-combat damage punishes him for standing in melee once isolated.
Burn damage scales with his tankier late-game armor stacking and keeps ticking through his W (Indestructible)-style shields his build doesn't actually have — it just outlasts his HP bar in a 1v1.

situational.when: he builds into crit or armor-shred physical items and his autos are doing most of the work
you need the healing from W (Indestructible) and Riftmaker to amplify further in a grindy lane
his early poke and auto trades before level 6 are too severe to just out-sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Every spell you land in melee range stacks Conqueror toward adaptive healing — since your entire win condition is surviving the walk-up phase and grinding him down once you're in range, that compounding sustain is what turns a close duel into a won one.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest-pick (73.9%) and strongest-performing (42.9%) option, and it matches the matchup's actual win condition: forcing and closing out the level 1-2 and level 6 all-in windows before he can disengage with Disdain.

playing.title: All-in before level 3
playing.detail: Urgot has no Disdain until level 3, so there's no dash-away to punish — if he trades or overextends for CS, your Q (Obliterate, 8s cooldown at rank 1) wins the exchange clean.

playing.title: Track Disdain's cooldown
playing.detail: E (Disdain) sits at 16-14s cooldown early. The moment he spends it — to poke, to clear wave, or to space you — that's your window to walk up without fear of being thrown back.

playing.title: Pull right after his Q
playing.detail: Fire E (Death's Grasp) the instant he lands Corrosive Charge, since its 8-10s cooldown means he has no follow-up slow to fight the pull and separate again.

playing.title: Isolate with R the instant E is down
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags him away from minions and support and locks the fight to melee-only. Use it the moment Disdain is on cooldown so he has no way to contest the duel on his terms.

playing.title: Pre-shield before committing
playing.detail: Pop W (Indestructible) before you walk into an extended trade — the stored damage converts to healing mid-fight, which matters since his autos plus Echoing Flames chip you continuously.

playing.title: Don't walk into a Purge channel
playing.detail: W (Purge) triggers extra Echoing Flames procs and prioritizes champions he's recently hit. Wait for the channel to end or interrupt the setup with E instead of absorbing it.

playing.title: Respect his execute range at low HP
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death) is a 2500-range execute on low-health targets. Even if you're winning a skirmish, don't let your HP drop into his threshold while his ultimate is up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, boots, and summoner spells are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the kit, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (P) and (E). Use your abilities to fight him in melee combat to easily gain control over lane.
